text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even in the stands of the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), the sheer strength of Triple 
Crown Umamusume Symboli Rudolf was the 
talk of the crowd. They believed that even 
six crowns would not be a mere dream for 
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The young channel administrator laments. 
Despite having the potential to become the 
strongest Umamusume in history, why 
doesn't Mr. C.B. show any motivation?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Mr. C.B. paid no mind to the stir 
in the stands. With her heart racing with 
excitement, she faced the race.
